pages.pageTitle: Provide evidence for merging duplicate records
pages.title: Provide evidence for merging duplicate records for {pupilName} (Optional)
pages.content:
If the same student appears twice in your performance data and the records need to be combined into a single student record.

Information or evidence you must provide

  • CYPMD ID of the student record that should be deleted or merged into the other record
  • details explaining why the student records should be merged

questions.title: Upload files
questions.hint: Evidence must be in a PDF format
